summary: Keep large Web session inventories warm and make mobile history recovery explicit and read-only without changing Run authority.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing SessionStore metadata cache and Web V2 conversation components; no new API, task execution or authorization owner.
components.disposition: Increase the bounded metadata-only cache to cover the measured 7,426-file workspace, preserve history on read failures, offer a read-only retry, and keep mobile history pagination scroll anchored.
evidence: 2026-11-23 production read-only baseline: /api/v1/sessions 17.975s, 1,199,891 response bytes; 7,426 workspace session files and 2,048 metadata cache slots.
